title: James Webb and Euclid telescopes discover record-breaking black hole at the edge of the universe
caption:
Astronomers have spotted the earliest-known quasar, Dún Aonghasa, dating back to just 630 million years after the Big Bang. Its surprisingly slow growth rate is forcing scientists to rethink how supermassive black holes expanded in the early universe.
